title: Prospective Survey of Menstrual Migraine & Prevention With Eletriptan
brief_summary: Women are followed prospectively for 3 months, recording headaches, other symptoms, and menstrual periods. Those with menstrual migraine are treated perimenstrually with eletriptan for 3 months.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age 18-45 healthy menstruating female

Exclusion Criteria:

* cardiac or other conditions precluding use of eletriptan
